title: Medulla anatomy scope: foundation to applied undergraduate anatomy
scopeNote: Original product taxonomy for a curriculum coverage tracker. This is not a complete atlas, a reproduction of any source syllabus, or a claim that all modules are implemented.
yearMappingNote: Foundation is a suggested Year 1 path and applied is a suggested Year 2 consolidation path. Institutions sequence anatomy differently; a school syllabus must be mapped before claiming year-level completeness.
reviewNote: No expert medical review has been completed for this taxonomy. Every objective requires a source-checked content item, accurate licensed visual when relevant, an assessment and reviewer approval before coverage can be marked complete.
baselineNote: The existing Medulla release has regional identification drills. This research does not inspect their exact implementation. All module statuses here are roadmap until the app owner maps actual questions and diagrams.
atlasNote: Atlas-reading labels are original search guidance. They do not claim access to a proprietary atlas, endorse a specific edition, or invent plate/page numbers. Compare an illustration atlas and a legally accessed 3D atlas app where available.
